verdict.rationale: Next.js is a code-first React framework with no product UI whose actions could be mirrored by an API, so UI-versus-API parity is a category error for this kind of product. The built-in MCP endpoint and the API-routes feature are about apps built with Next.js, and the openapi.json probe is of unknown content tied to the website. None of these shows a product UI with API parity, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
